title: System Stacking
hook: My morning walk doubles as podcast research and sales prep.
statement: Make one action serve several goals.
explainer: Time is your scarcest asset. One action, three results, one price.
sop: Find a second goal each could hit.
equation_example: Goals Served 3 ÷ Actions Taken 1 = 3.0. At 1.0, you pay full price per goal.
question: Pick one weekly task. Write two more goals it serves.
closing_statement: One action, one goal is the expensive default.
